alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one registered slider perturbation yields a measurable shape/scalar/parametrization deviation at a matched checkpoint.
assumptions: KnotPlot runtime parameter dumps are authoritative for numerical defaults when the build reports a slider; a preregistered explicit default may be used for an anonymous GUI control that is accepted by the setter but omitted from `parameters` (S3 has user-confirmed frozen reset default value 1.40 and R2 reset switch OFF for this build; the enabled R2 sector reference uses S3=1.40).
reset all supplies the requested Damped baseline and collision fast supplies collision avoidance / No Collide.
Only the sector associated with the currently tested slider is explicitly enabled; unrelated controls remain at reset-all state.

A single preregistered geometric fitto-mindist normalization prepares one shared safe seed during installation; no fitto or resampling occurs in any scientific condition and close, max-dr, stusplit, dstep, timeincr and all unrelated controls retain their runtime reset defaults.

The raw 300-bead catalogue trefoil may be unsafe at its original embedding scale; the single controlled seed-preparation scaling to 1.05 times the measured close default must pass KnotPlot safe checks both before and after reloading, and is common to every condition. This changes the absolute initial geometry scale and can affect physical force trajectories; scientific interpretations are conditional on this fixed seed.

The velocity-dependent sector is enabled with its runtime switch and tested under Damped as requested, even though KnotPlot emits a GUI/load note that Undamped dynamics is intended for velocity-dependent force. S7 is therefore interpreted as a Damped compatibility/response lane, not as the canonical intended Undamped use case.
R2 is OFF in reset-all state; the independent activation control differs from R2 ON reference only by the R2 switch, keeping both R2 numeric sliders fixed at their registered values.

BASIC means 512 go iterations per selected condition at checkpoints 32,128,512; 2048 means full registered design at 32,128,512,2048; 32768 means no more than 31 preselected conditions at 32,128,512,2048,8192,32768.

32768 condition selection is precommitted from the earlier BASIC or preferably 2048 matched-iteration runlog; selects all qualified sector references, activation control and up to three perturbations per axis by deterministic rule.
A finite-time response at 512, 2048 or 32768 is NOT a converged or stable attractor. Observed collision safety is verified separately.

If a force sector crashes or cannot advance (e.g. a freeglut headless failure), record unsupported runtime explicitly and continue other sectors; do not count unavailable conditions as successful evidence.
All modes preserve previous raw run data in independent run directories and Framework-v1.0.8 publication archives.
edge_cases: Exact-zero endpoints are excluded from logarithmic/quadratic fits.
A zero runtime default makes multiplicative default-relative sweeping undefined and fails install calibration.

A slider absent from a sector-context `parameters` dump is permitted only when its frozen private axis contract supplies an explicit nonzero default and `verification=setter_acceptance`; otherwise install calibration fails closed.
Safety-cap termination is diagnostic non-convergence, not convergence at the cap.
A slider may change convergence time strongly while leaving final geometry nearly invariant.
Velocity-dependent-force results are regime-specific because this campaign intentionally retains Damped although the KnotPlot UI/load note recommends Undamped for that force.
An OFF sector may hide its numeric controls from the runtime parameter dump; compare accepted setters with explicit switch readback when reported, and retain weaker-evidence annotation when absent.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any registered sector-enable command is rejected, any runtime-reportable slider fails numeric round-trip, or any explicitly preregistered non-reporting slider setter is rejected.

The one-time shared seed normalization does not produce a safe 300-bead curve, the normalized ASCII reload is unsafe, a post-reload one-step check is unsafe, the seed bytes differ across conditions, or a registered reset-default research control is changed.
No qualified anonymous slider changes matched-iteration shape/scalar above the registered noise floors at the observed tier checkpoint.
A selected condition fails safe collision constraints, cannot execute a checkpoint, cannot be verified via parameter state, or a runtime-incompatible sector cannot be tested.

null_hypothesis: H0: no registered slider perturbation changes matched-iteration geometry beyond numerical noise under the declared baseline/seed.
objective: Quantify finite-time shape/scalar/parametrization response, reproducible across checkpoints; qualify compatibility and execution failures; do not infer convergence at a fixed budget.

observables.definition: Finite-time default-relative normalized shape response at matched iteration checkpoints, not a converged final state.
Recorded iteration checkpoints, actual budget and inter-checkpoint motion with NO convergence certification.
Edge-spacing coefficient of variation used to separate parametrization response from embedded-shape response.

predictions: Amplitude-like sliders may primarily alter final geometry magnitude; exponent-like sliders may change response-law shape.
A predominantly tangential redistribution control may change edge-spacing statistics more strongly than arclength-resampled embedded shape.
A damping-like control may change N_conv more strongly than final D_shape.
The velocity-dependent control may alter transient and/or final geometry under Damped, but any such response is explicitly conditional on this non-intended regime pairing.
An R2 OFF-versus-ON contrast at identical numeric defaults may differ from the continuous S3 strength response, so it is reported separately.
research_question: How do eight anonymous KnotPlot GUI controls change the same trefoil after matched finite time horizons of 512, 2048 and selectively 32768 go iterations compared with their sector-default references?

steps.operation: Runtime-probe eight anonymous slider parameters in six enabled sector contexts; verify assignment-form setters and sector switches; for a preregistered non-reporting control use its frozen explicit default plus setter-acceptance verification; verify the Damped + collision-fast regime; and export exactly one safe trefoil during installation. Prepare exactly one shared ASCII safe seed with a one-time geometry-scale normalization at 1.05 times the measured close default; reload it and check safety before and after go 1, while keeping all dynamics/default parameters unchanged.

Generate six enabled-sector default references, one additional matched R2-OFF activation control, and eight default-relative one-slider-at-a-time sweeps on the quarter-octave ladder with zero endpoints.
Observe all 271 conditions at go 32,128,512 in BASIC and 32,128,512,2048 in extended tier; no adaptive convergence claim; store separate run identities.
Compute matched-iteration shape and scalar responses relative to each sector reference; distinguish missing runtime lanes and numerical failures.
Certify coordinate-derived scalar metrics with C++17/pybind11 FP64 against Python FP64.

Preselect at most 31 conditions from prior matched-iteration evidence with deterministic selection preserving references and up to three responses per axis; follow to go 32768 with interim checkpoints.
After commitment-verified reveal only, attach GUI slider and sector names to the frozen anonymous response curves, including the registered Damped-regime caveat for the velocity-dependent sector.

Execute one separately registered R2 switch-OFF control with the identical S3/S4 numerical default setters as the enabled R2 reference, and compare final shapes without pooling this binary contrast into any slider response fit.
